facts.claim: Null output-stage pointer returnsAL0. Otherwise sets stage0. First GetFileAttributesW==0xffffffff jumps toAL1 without inspecting GetLastError. This is an absent-like query branch, not proven absence. Present-like journal is checked again with mask0x410; CreateFileW/ReadFile16/CloseHandle then existing magic/version/xor/stage1..5 checks. Read/open/bad header returnsAL0; trailing bytes not inspected.

First deletes journal.new via0x40f110 allowMissing1; failure stops before reading journal. Successful journal reader chooses stage0/1/2..4/5 branches below. Successful selected cleanup returnsAL1; required cleanup/journal deletion failure returnsAL0. Does not independently establish present target identity or account/game success.
Presence helper is only GetFileAttributesW!=0xffffffff. It does not test0x410 or GetLastError and is not a regular-file validator.

Delete helper succeeds for missing-like query only when allowMissing is nonzero and GetLastError==2. Other invalid attributes fail, including error3. Existing mask0x410 objects are rejected. Otherwise actual DeleteFileW success is required. Null error-output pointer suppresses diagnostics, not failure AL0.

Move helper requires source attributes neither invalid nor0x410 and destination attributes invalid. Then MoveFileExW(source,destination,8);AL1 only actual call success. Destination invalid query is not a proven absence check. No overwrite flag or independent handle/file identity claim.

Initial backup attributes invalid returnsAL1 without moving. Otherwise regular backup required. Existing target is rechecked for0x410, failed-path deletion is attempted with ignored result, then target->failed via0x40d910. Next backup->target via0x40d910. If second move fails and failed is present-like while target invalid, attempts MoveFileExW(failed,target,8), still returnsAL0. On backup->target success, failed cleanup is best effort and function returnsAL1.
